backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time of restore_point, proven by supabase-restore-check-on-alfred.sh the same session. Apply within one hour of it or take a new backup. The release is additive (new tables, new *_v1 functions, three nullable columns on inventory_items, two nullable columns on ops_notices) but it also REPLACES record_inventory_usage with a contract-compatible v2, so a restore point is mandatory.

forward_verification.name: metrics_rpc_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='get_hospitality_metrics_v1')

forward_verification.name: overview_rpc_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='get_admin_overview_v1')

forward_verification.name: posting_rpc_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='post_journal_v1')

forward_verification.name: journals_rls_enabled
forward_verification.query: select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='public.acct_journals'::regclass

forward_verification.name: no_item_flipped_to_movement_control
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.inventory_items where movement_controlled_at is not null)

forward_verification.name: record_inventory_usage_signature_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='record_inventory_usage' and pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)='p_property_id uuid, p_session_date date, p_logged_by text, p_notes text, p_rows jsonb')

rollback.safe_until: no journal has been posted and no inventory item has been baseline-reconciled; after that the compensating script refuses and acct_* plus inventory_stock_movements data must be kept

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20260913_admin_modernisation_backend.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: restores record_inventory_usage v1 and removes the v1 RPCs and new tables. It raises if acct_journals rows or movement-controlled items exist.

feature_flags.name: admin_v2_entry_point
feature_flags.required_state: the new admin build (admin-dashboard dist/) is deployed separately; applying this release alone changes nothing user-facing. Existing PWAs keep working: record_inventory_usage v2 behaves identically for items that have not been baseline-reconciled.

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed 2026-09-13 with scripts/recovery/p6/migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh against restored set cascade-supabase-20260913T000007Z: 3 migrations applied in order, 9/9 forward checks, pgTAP admin_read_models_v1 22/22, accounting_foundation_v1 24/24, inventory_movement_compat_v1 10/10 (56 assertions). Fix found by the suites: acct_balances_v1 and the cash-flow statement now treat the approved opening-balance journal (event_kind opening_balance, dated on accounting_start) as opening position, not period activity. record_inventory_usage keeps its identity arguments and return shape (ok, rows) and adds movements; the inventory PWA and submit-cleaning never read movements.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
the rehearsal (migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh with the three pgTAP suites) has not passed against the same migration bytes (migration_sha256)
